travel.headline: Plan Your Visit to Lulworth Estate and Jurassic Coast Highlights
travel.reservation: Access to the Lulworth Estate landmarks like the Cove and Durdle Door is generally open, though specific events or activities like mobility scooter hire require direct contact with the Visitor Centre. Check official sources for parking availability at BH20 5RQ as these sites accommodate thousands of visitors annually. Access to certain areas like the Fossil Forest may be restricted; always verify current openings via the Lulworth Estate website.
